title: British Cod and Shepherd's Pie Italian Fusion
description: A creative Italian twist to the classic British Shepherd's Pie, featuring pan-seared cod and a rich tomato sauce.

ingredients.name: Shepherd's pie mix (beef, lamb, and vegetables)

instructions: Season the cod fillets with salt and pepper. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and sear the cod for 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a baking dish.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil and sauté the garlic for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the shepherd's pie mix and cook until browned, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the crushed tomatoes, white wine, and Italian seasoning. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the sauce simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Transfer the sauce to the baking dish with the cod and top with mozzarella cheese and breadcrumbs.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
